- Large scroll steps (5000px) on the original page, then extraction.
- A fresh page with small steps (300px, 300px, then 1000px), then extraction.
- Scrolling to the bottom link, then observing the viewport.

Every extraction returned the same 10 quotes, ending with "A day without sunshine is like, you know, night." by Steve Martin. The page never added a second batch, so there is no 11th quote to report. The page may use a load trigger that these scroll actions don't fire, or the batch may load only after a longer wait, but I did not confirm either.
